gaps.title: Dataset source identification
gaps.current_state: No pilot dataset source is selected or approved.
gaps.required_action: Select a bounded source through the responsible approval process.
gaps.completion_criteria: An approved source record exists and is accepted by the responsible process.

gaps.title: Data ownership and controller roles
gaps.current_state: Ownership and controller roles are not documented.
gaps.required_action: Document ownership, controller, processor and withdrawal authority.
gaps.completion_criteria: A reviewed ownership record resolves all responsible roles.

gaps.title: Collection and research-use permissions
gaps.current_state: Collection and research-use permissions are not approved.
gaps.required_action: Obtain explicit permission for collection, transformation, annotation and research use.
gaps.completion_criteria: Permission artifacts exist, cover the planned operations and are accepted by the responsible process.

gaps.title: Privacy and sensitive-data review
gaps.current_state: Privacy review and sensitive-data assessment are incomplete.
gaps.required_action: Complete a privacy assessment including personal and sensitive data classes.
gaps.completion_criteria: The privacy artifact exists and is accepted by the responsible review process.

gaps.title: Retention policy
gaps.current_state: No approved pilot retention schedule exists.
gaps.required_action: Define and approve purpose-bound retention periods for every data class.
gaps.completion_criteria: An approved retention schedule covers all planned dataset entities and detached payloads.

gaps.title: Deletion and withdrawal process
gaps.current_state: Deletion and withdrawal procedures are not tested.
gaps.required_action: Define and test deletion across primary storage, backups and derived artifacts.
gaps.completion_criteria: A controlled deletion test passes and its limitations are recorded.

gaps.title: Dataset access control
gaps.current_state: Pilot-specific least-privilege roles and access review are not approved.
gaps.required_action: Define storage roles, access approval, review and revocation.
gaps.completion_criteria: The access-control record is approved and a denial/revocation test is documented.

gaps.title: Dataset schema freeze
gaps.current_state: Draft schemas exist but are not frozen for pilot execution.
gaps.required_action: Freeze schema versions, migration rules and compatibility policy.
gaps.completion_criteria: A freeze record binds exact schema hashes and change authority.

gaps.title: Approved validation sample
gaps.current_state: No approved non-main sample exists for pipeline validation.
gaps.required_action: Prepare an approved, bounded sample only after source and permission gates pass.
gaps.completion_criteria: The sample manifest passes source, permission, leakage and split checks.

gaps.title: Annotation protocol approval
gaps.required_action: Freeze and approve the codebook, instructions, adjudication and agreement plan.
gaps.completion_criteria: The protocol is version-frozen and accepted by the responsible process.

gaps.title: Pilot-specific environment freeze
gaps.current_state: Local synthetic environment checks pass, but no pilot-specific environment is frozen.
gaps.required_action: Freeze the isolated pilot environment, dependencies, assets and reproduction procedure.
gaps.completion_criteria: The exact pilot environment is identified and its controlled reproduction test passes.

gaps.title: Safety controls and explicit execution approval
gaps.current_state: Safety policies are defined, but the safety gate remains STOP and no execution approval exists.
gaps.required_action: Verify sandbox controls and stop authority, then obtain a separate explicit execution approval only after all critical gaps are evidence-ready.
gaps.completion_criteria: Safety controls are tested and a separate scoped execution approval is accepted after critical prerequisites pass.

reassessment_criteria: Every gap has status EVIDENCE_READY or CLOSED.
Every gap has one or more evidence references.
The readiness matrix is updated in a separate change.
Safety stop conditions remain active until a new review computes GO.
A new review does not inherit approval from this plan.
limitations: This plan does not resolve any gap or approve any evidence.
Required future evidence names are artifact requirements, not existing artifacts.
The current readiness decision remains NO_GO and pilot execution remains unauthorized.
recommended_next_pr: Re-run SAEE Pilot Execution Readiness Review after gap evidence exists
